implementation: Flutter profile panel now follows frontend/src/design/settings.css: centered 720 px settings column, 480 px forms, 64 px avatar, 24 px desktop and 16 px compact page insets, 16 px page title, and separated password/notifications/logout sections. The panel uses the web's responsive action toolbar rather than a second title header; its visible Back/navigation actions follow the same breakpoints.

checks.name: Profile desktop/compact geometry, form/avatar sizes and focus widgets
checks.observation: Geometry checks assert a centered 720 px column at 1440 px and 358 px content with 16 px insets at 390 px; form max width is 480 px and avatar radius 32 px. Header semantics/focus and live mutation state are also covered.

checks.name: Workspace profile route toolbar and unique heading
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "profile panel matches web toolbar without a duplicate heading"
checks.observation: Desktop route renders one Profile heading, hides the navigation/menu, participant and Back actions that web CSS hides at this breakpoint. Android-width route exposes Back/navigation (not participant actions), and Back returns to the workspace.

remaining: Matched web/Flutter screenshots at desktop breakpoints and Android portrait, physical keyboard/screen-reader acceptance, Android Gboard, and Windows-native build remain open in the parity checklist.
